activity.notes: Sigismund II Augustus became sole King of Poland in 1548 and remained king through the Union of Lublin. To avoid duplicating the existing Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth Activity beginning on 1 July 1569, ATLAS records only the pre-Commonwealth Kingdom of Poland phase here, ending at the union boundary.

sources.title: Inventing the Grand Duchy of Finland in the 1580s — Scandinavian Journal of History
sources.citation_text: The scholarly article identifies Sigismund II Augustus as King of Poland and Grand Duke of Lithuania from 1548 to 1572 and distinguishes the pre-1569 personal union from the Commonwealth created by the Union of Lublin.
